decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) 485–544 where N and E jointly dip but diverge in recovery, and (2) 545–664 where E drops steadily while N rises oppositely, suggesting non-uniform deformation or measurement artifact. No single-edge events qualify as complete temporary offsets; both regions include sufficient context for change and possible return.
